default.description: What the island window may call: events, every feature, settings (read, and write for plugins that remember choices), the third-party plugins to load, their secrets, and signing them in to online accounts.

overlay.description: The capture overlay: read the capture, copy or save the annotated image, hide itself.

popup.description: The shortcut popup: read settings and clipboard history, copy, paste, hide itself; the command palette's apps, files and actions, the other commands it runs, and opening Settings or quitting from it.

settings.description: The settings window: read and write settings, toggle launch at login, try shortcuts, list or open the third-party plugins folder, browse and install from the community store, save plugins' secrets (without reading them back), test AI providers (list their models), install or remove the local PersonaPlex server, check for and install updates, and preview zone layouts.

zones.description: The zones overlay: read what to draw and the accent color, snap the picked window, change screens, cancel.
